rate_limits: Daily quotas by plan (free: 100 requests/day); Free plan: 1 request/second; paid plans: 10 requests/second
resolution_notes: rate_limits: Auditor correct. Official error-handling docs publish per-second limits under HTTP 429: Free plan 1 req/s, paid plans 10 req/s (https://docs.gnews.io/error-handling). Free daily quota of 100/day confirmed on pricing (https://gnews.io/pricing). Original claim that per-second limits were 'not clearly published' is wrong.
